subject: ZAFFER CAIQ: control mapping, evidence origins, and ops locator
messages:
From: Elena Voss <elena.voss@zaffer.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: audit-team@zaffer.com
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ mapping request + sample evidence origins

Hi Connor —

Thanks again for taking the call earlier. As part of Zaffer Health's security review we need the CAIQ mapping for Redwood's hosted inference offering (hosted API + dedicated pool surface). Our ask is:

1) A completed CAIQ spreadsheet (we've attached the template).
2) For each CSA control you map to, the originating evidence artifact(s) and the shortest path to obtain them (who/where). Examples: log sample (S3 path or portal), config screenshot, owner attestation doc.
3) A contact list for operational owners who can provide live samples or short walkthroughs during our window (11/16–11/30).

Deliverables requested by 11/10 if possible. We appreciate any pre-work you can provide so the audit time is minimized.

Attachments: zaffer-caiq-template.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Elena Voss
Senior Security Assessor
Zaffer Health — Vendor Risk Team
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elena Voss <elena.voss@zaffer.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 17:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping request + sample evidence origins

Elena —

Appreciate the clear ask. We'll take point on the mapping and provide an evidence locator doc that lists: control -> artifact name -> storage path / owner / estimated pull steps. Preliminary plan below:

- By 11/10: draft CAIQ mapping populated (CSV) and a short evidence index for high-risk controls.
- By 11/12: package of redacted log samples + screenshots for controls that require runtime proof.
- Week of 11/16: schedule 45-min walkthrough(s) with our infra/ops owners if you want live access.

Action owners (internal):
- Connor O'Brien: coordination, CAIQ mapping consolidation, HubSpot ticketing
- Marissa Cole: evidence collection (logs, screenshots, config exports)
- Jordan Blake: control annotations and cryptographic key notes

Questions for you before we start:
1) Any controls you want us to prioritize (P0)?
2) Do you need raw logs or redacted samples for tenant-scope-sensitive controls?

I'm attaching a first-pass CSV skeleton and will push a fuller draft tomorrow.

Attachments: caiq-mapping-skeleton.csv (csv)

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior Sales Engineer, Enterprise Security
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 09:21:00 -0500
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping request + sample evidence origins

Connor / Jordan —

Uploading the draft mapping per Connor's timeline. Notes:

- Attached: caiq-mapping-draft.csv contains three sheets (mapping, evidence-index, owner-contacts).
- Evidence origins: most telemetry is in s3://redwood-prod-telemetry/tenanted/YYYYMM where we can pull 2-hour redacted windows. Runtime snapshots (KV cache, batching telemetry) are sampled via our internal runbook (infra-docs link included).
- Sensitive controls (tenant isolation / data residency): we will provide redacted log extracts and a signed attestation from Cloud Ops; raw logs require an NDA amendment — can we route that via DocuSign?

Open questions for Zaffer:
- Confirm sample window (default 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-15 is proposed).
- Any required retention proof (e.g., 90/180/365 days)?

Attachments: caiq-mapping-draft.csv (csv)
Related links: https://internal.redwood/docs/evidence-runbook (internal)

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping request + sample evidence origins

Elena —

Thanks for the prompt review. Attached is the evidence bundle we discussed: a zipped archive with redacted logs, config exports, screenshots, and a short owner-attestation PDF. Key highlights:

- evidence-bundle-zaffer-20261109.zip (contains: runtime-logs-redacted.txt, s3-config-export.json, keystore-attestation.pdf, kvcache-snapshot.png)
- We provided explicit storage paths and the owner contact for each artifact in the mapping CSV (see column: "artifact_location" and "owner_email").
- For tenant-sensitive raw logs: per Marissa, raw pull requires an NDA amendment / DocuSign. I've included a DocuSign link for the Zaffer access agreement here: https://docusign.com/ZAFFER-ACCESS-AGREEMENT-abc123

Proposed next steps:
1) Elena confirms sample window (we proposed 2026-10-01 -> 2026-10-15).
2) Zaffer e-signs the DocuSign to enable a 1-hour live session if you want deeper dives into raw telemetry.
3) We schedule walkthroughs with Cloud Ops (Jordan) and Platform SRE (Marissa) during 11/16–11/30.
